title: ozoroa cinerea
intro: Ozoroa cinerea, commonly known as the White Milk Bush or Elephant's Tusk, is a plant species native to southern Africa, belonging to the Burseraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ozoroa cinerea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The plant's bioactive constituents also contribute to its potential as an antiseptic and a natural remedy for skin conditions.
